subject: Data Engineering
title: Future of Cloud Data Platforms
description: One-minute skill: Future of Cloud Data Platforms.

hook.text: Cloud data platforms evolve so fast that today's best practice is next year's legacy approach.

buildup.text: Trends: AI-integrated warehouses, automated optimization, natural language queries, and unified lakehouses.

discovery.text: Platforms are converging. Warehouses add lake features. Lakes add warehouse features. The boundary blurs.

twist.text: The cloud providers themselves are being challenged by platform companies like Snowflake and Databricks.

climax.text: The future favors platforms that are open, intelligent, and simple — regardless of which cloud they run on.

punchline.text: The platform war isn't over. It's just getting started.

quiz.question: What major trend is shaping the future of cloud data platforms?
options: Convergence of data lake and data warehouse capabilities
